blocks.title: Air Quality Index
blocks.text: Hawa ka mayar Air Quality Index (AQI) se napa jata hai, kisi khaas jagah hawa mein maujood pollutants ki concentrations ka paimana. Jab hawa ka mayar achha ho to hawa saaf hoti hai aur us mein thos zarraat aur kimiyai pollutants ki sirf thori miqdar hoti hai; kharab mayar, zyada darjon ke saath, aksar dhundla aur sehat aur mahol ke liye khatarnak hota hai.

50 se kam AQI achha samjha jata hai: sehat ko khatre ke baghair bahar waqt guzarna mehfooz hai. 300 se zyada AQI khatarnak (hazardous) hai. 18 saal se kam bachche, 65 se zyada umr ke log aur dil aur phephron ki purani bimariyon wale zyada khatre mein hain, aur bahar kaam karne wale lambe samne ki wajah se zyada khatre mein.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: sabz 0 se 50 se peele, narangi, surkh aur banafshi se ho kar maroon 301 se 500 tak chhe rangon ki AQI patti sehat ki fikr ke labels ke saath. Oopar daen: PM, NO2 aur SO2 ke sehat par asrat aur chaar bunyadi khatre. Darmiyan baen: monitoring ke aalaat aur hawa ke mayar ke tajurbe ke qadam. Darmiyan daen: chaar control technologies. Neeche: Pakistan ke qawaneen, control ke iqdamat aur maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail.
blocks.caption: Air Quality Index, sehat par asrat, monitoring ke tareeqe, control technologies aur zabta (Table 14.2, Figure 14.6 aur topics 14.8 se 14.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Air Quality Index pollutant concentrations ko achhe se khatarnak tak chhe rangeen pattiyon mein badalta hai, bachche, buzurg, bimar aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein. Particulate matter, nitrogen dioxide aur sulfur dioxide saans ki naliyon ko jalate aur waqt ke saath asthma, bronchitis, dil ki bimari aur cancer karte hain. Nephelometers, musalsal emission monitors, muqarrar stations aur satellites pollutants napte hain, aur rush hour mein zyada PM2.5 jaisi hypothesis mansooba-band sampling aur tajziye se parkhi jati hai. Catalytic converters, particulate filters, selective catalytic reduction aur scrubbers zariye par ikhraj ghatate hain, Pakistan mein Environmental Protection Act, qaumi mayar ke standards aur Punjab ki tarmeem ki pusht-panahi, aur saaf fuels se smog control tak ke iqdamat ke saath, jabke aaloodgi ki qeemat paidawar, faslon, kamzoron aur sarhadon ke paar siyasat par parti hai.

blocks.caption: AQI aur sehat ki fikr ka darja (Table 14.2)

blocks.prompt: AQI kya hai aur yeh hawa ka mayar kaise napta hai; us ke darje kya hain, aur kaun si ranges sab se mehfooz aur sab se khatarnak hain (Quick Check 14.4b, c; MCQ VIII)?
blocks.explanation: AQI kisi jagah bunyadi pollutants (PM, NO2, SO2, CO, ozone) ki napi gai concentrations se nikala ek akela number hai, 0 se 500 tak. Us ke darje achha (0-50, sabz), darmiyana (51-100, peela), hassas groups ke liye ghair-sehatmand (101-150, narangi), ghair-sehatmand (151-200, surkh), bohat ghair-sehatmand (201-300, banafshi) aur khatarnak (301-500, maroon) hain; 0 se 50 sab se mehfooz aur 301 se 500 sab se khatarnak.

items: AQI kisi jagah pollutant concentrations napta hai: 50 se kam achha aur bahar mehfooz, 300 se zyada khatarnak; sabz se maroon tak chhe pattiyan (Table 14.2); bachche, buzurg, dil aur phephron ke mareez aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein.
